name: PromptBro
author: supercleanse
description: A teleprompter that follows your voice. Load a script from the bar, and PromptBro shows it a few lines at a time under the bar and scrolls as you speak. Speech recognition runs on your machine (sherpa-onnx, no cloud, no account, no GPU).

barWidget.description: Script icon that shows whether PromptBro is listening. Click it to open a script, paste one, move a line up or down, restart, pause, show or hide the prompter, and quit.

schema.label: Show line progress next to the icon
